premises.text: Interactive classroom whiteboard content is locked to each manufacturer's software and to the classroom, so teachers and students cannot access it from home
premises.evidence_span: your content is locked not only into your platform, but it's locked into the classroom

premises.text: Browser-based interactive lessons work on any device with a browser and support simultaneous multi-user interaction without installed software
An equation tool with live graphing lets users type math that auto-formats and updates graphs as equations change
premises.evidence_span: you can see the graph updating as you change the equation, a totally new way of interacting with math

premises.text: Publish makes lessons globally accessible with embeds, links, PDF, and offline classroom downloads
Professional publishers can build rich interactive lessons with the tools in hours instead of native software
premises.evidence_span: building it in hours instead of a native piece of software

value.text: Interactive educational content usable on any browser device, including from home, not locked to classroom hardware
value.evidence_span: it works on any device that has a browser

secondary_value.text: End Texas Instruments' classroom graphing monopoly with computer-based math interaction
secondary_value.evidence_span: Texas Instruments, your monopoly on graphing in the classroom is over
